'''Raefar Kisman''' was an [[Asha'man]]. He had reached the rank of [[Asha'man]] and was one of [[Mazrim Taim]]'s men.

== Appearance ==
He was younger than [[Rand al'Thor]], of average height and pale for a Tairen.

== History ==
He was from [[Tear]].

== Activities ==
He carried away [[Peral Torval]] after he had been clubbed unconsious by [[Mazrim Taim]]. He fought in the [[Battle of Dumai's Wells]]. After Rand chose Dashiva to stay with him after Dumai's Wells, Taim stalked away, calling for [[Gedwyn]], Rochaid, Torval and Kisman.{{ref/book|7|2}} 

After the attack on the Sun Palace, he deserted.{{ref/book|7|29}} His name was placed on the deserter's list, to the surprise of [[Androl Genhald]].{{ref/book|9|p}} He was commanded by Taim, [[Demandred]] and [[Moridin]] to kill Rand. After the assassination attempt on Rand's life by the rogue Asha'man, Taim reported to Rand that Kisman was a deserter. He followed Rand's trail to [[Far Madding]] where he confronted Rand. He was forced to flee after accidently killing his partner [[Manel Rochaid]]. He was later stabbed by [[Padan Fain]] with the [[Shadar Logoth]] dagger and died soon after.{{ref/book|9|22}}
